statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-107928: when curl is built with GnuTLS, a malicious WebSocket server can make curl send memory past its send buffer, because gnutls_record_send() can report more bytes sent than it was given after a blocked send. Only GnuTLS builds are affected; curl 8.23.0 hardens lib/vtls/gtls.c: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-107928.html, https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/64fb3e7a7b116f690966054f281624152d4a7651. No published build of this owner uses GnuTLS: Alpine's curl APKBUILD configures --with-openssl (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/856d76205ed1b7f875d32fd7b72eb93912f32acd/main/curl/APKBUILD). Unpacked every published curl package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64, as curl, libcurl, curl-dev, curl-static, curl-dbg, curl-doc, curl-fish-completion and curl-zsh-completion. Their programs and shared libraries are the curl program and the libcurl.so.4 shared library, both dynamically linked against musl. libcurl links OpenSSL, zlib, c-ares, nghttp2, libidn2, libpsl, zstd and brotli; 8.17.0-r1 and 8.18.0-r0 also link nghttp3; no ELF file links an SSH library (libssh2, libssh or wolfSSH), an LDAP library or GnuTLS. curl-static ships the static libcurl.a, whose members are all libcurl's own object files; curl-dbg holds only detached debug information for curl and libcurl. No package contains a PE or Mach-O file. In every libcurl.a the gtls object, compiled from lib/vtls/gtls.c, defines no symbols. The GnuTLS code the advisory describes is not in any build.

CVE-2026-107928: when curl is built with GnuTLS, a malicious WebSocket server can make curl send memory past its send buffer, because gnutls_record_send() can report more bytes sent than it was given after a blocked send. Only GnuTLS builds are affected; curl 8.23.0 hardens lib/vtls/gtls.c: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-107928.html, https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/64fb3e7a7b116f690966054f281624152d4a7651. No published build of this owner uses GnuTLS: Alpine's curl APKBUILD configures --with-openssl (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/c65a7b3f6d6bc4b3c0a8a6fff759d8fd05a167ce/main/curl/APKBUILD). Unpacked every published curl package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository: 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.22.0-r1 and 8.23.0-r0, each for x86_64 and aarch64, as curl, libcurl, curl-dev, curl-static, curl-dbg, curl-doc, curl-fish-completion and curl-zsh-completion. Their programs and shared libraries are the curl program and the libcurl.so.4 shared library, both dynamically linked against musl. libcurl links OpenSSL, zlib, c-ares, nghttp2, libidn2, libpsl, zstd and brotli; no ELF file links an SSH library (libssh2, libssh or wolfSSH), an LDAP library or GnuTLS. curl-static ships the static libcurl.a, whose members are all libcurl's own object files; curl-dbg holds only detached debug information for curl and libcurl. No package contains a PE or Mach-O file. In every libcurl.a the gtls object, compiled from lib/vtls/gtls.c, defines no symbols. The GnuTLS code the advisory describes is not in any build.
